subject: CAIQ resolution runbook, on-call support & evidence handoff
messages:
From: Liza Monroe <liza.monroe@dexterhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ control clarifications + timeline for evidence samples

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the CAIQ package you sent last week. Our security team is doing a focused sampling for a scope that includes data-in-transit, key management and operational patching controls. Two asks from us to keep the audit moving: 

1) Can you share a short runbook (one-pager) that explains who our team should call or email during the evidence window if a control owner has a clarifying question? We want a named escalation path and expected response SLAs.
2) For the CAIQ control map, can you indicate which controls already have HARVESTED evidence (logs/configs) versus those that need a manual artifact pull? A simple "Harvested / Needs pull" column will do.

We plan to request a live sampling next week (June 2–4). Ideally we’d get the runbook and the control-status column by EOD Monday (May 31).

Thanks,
Liza
Liza Monroe
Director, Information Security
DexterHealth
liza.monroe@dexterhealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
To: Liza Monroe <liza.monroe@dexterhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.inference>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: RE: CAIQ control clarifications + timeline for evidence samples

Hi Liza — thanks for the note and the timeline. We can absolutely support the June 2–4 window. High level plan below and attachments included: caiq_control_map_v3.xlsx (with a new column "EvidenceStatus") and a short runbook PDF.

Quick plan and owners:
- Evidence status column: completed (HARVESTED) vs manual (NEEDS_PULL) or IN_PROGRESS. Karthik is the owner for infra and telemetry controls.
- Runbook: points to a dedicated on-call alias (security-evidence@redwood.inference) and an on-call rotation (Karthik -> Soojin -> Marissa, escalation to Head of Security). Expected response SLA: initial acknowledgement within 2 hours, substantive response within one business day for evidence pulls.
- Attachments: caiq_control_map_v3.xlsx (control-level crosswalk + EvidenceStatus), evidence_index_20270530.csv (artifact inventory), runbook_oncall_md.pdf (single-page escalation flow).

Actions for you: if that SLA works, confirm and we’ll mark the controls we can pre-harvest for the live sample. If you have specific control IDs you want prioritized, send them and we’ll queue them at the top.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Customer Security
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>

Looping in some additional context for the on-call runbook and evidence posture. Per the attached spreadsheet:
- KM-01, KM-02 (key management) => HARVESTED: HSM rotation logs and KMS audit are available for the sample, path noted in the EvidencePath column.
- DI-03 (data-in-transit) => IN_PROGRESS: we have capture policy configs but need to pull packet-level TLS termination proofs from the HA proxy logs (will take a manual extract).
- OP-05 (patch mgmt) => NEEDS_PULL: weekly compliance agent reports are retained in the Artifact Vault, we'll pull last 90 days on request.

Operational notes:
- Manual pulls will be completed within the substantive SLA window (one business day) for priority requests; lower-priority pulls will be scheduled within 3 business days. For live sampling we’ll prioritize harvested controls first and provide a parallel tracker for manual pulls.
- I’ll be standing by on June 2 during your sampling window and Soojin will join on June 3 for routing and artifact handoffs.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Lead, Evidence & Controls
Redwood Inference

Marissa, Karthik — this is perfect, thank you. SLA and runbook look fine to us. We reviewed the control-status column and will schedule live sampling for June 2 (harvested controls) and June 3 (manual pulls: OP-05).

A couple of follow-ups:
- Can you also add a short note in the runbook about how long extracted artifacts will be retained for our review window (we typically request 30 days)?
- Please share the DocuSign link for the attestation once you’ve updated the control map — our procurement team needs that before they ingest any artifacts.

If you can drop the updated runbook and docusign link by EOD today we’ll confirm times with our Schedulers.

Best,
Liza
